title: How much a baseball club accrues at signing for the plate-appearance bonuses in five free-agent hitters' 2027 contracts, each bonus at its expected amount for the 2027 season
subdomain: resampling-simulation-monte-carlo-methods (the expected value of stepped plate-appearance bonuses from the distribution of comparable whole seasons: the winter-planned regulars' seasons of starts, each read at the signing's 2027 lineup slot's plate appearances per start)
prompt_shape: a total accrual built from five players' accruals (fifteen bonus lines), a table of nine injured-list stints (date taken effect and regular-season days), a table of the plate-appearance bonuses paid for three seasons by player and in total, and a one-page memo

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task151/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional 30-club professional baseball league, its clubs (the Raleigh Oaks among them), its statistics feed and league office, a fictional projection vendor and the club's own finance, payroll and baseball operations systems; no real league, club, player, vendor or person is depicted. Box-score conventions (plate-appearance components, lineup slots, doubleheader and suspended-game numbering) and injured-list mechanics follow common professional baseball practice.
